_comment: Benign-divergence baseline for the redaction oracles. Records OUTCOMES on KNOWN-GOOD inputs that are EXPECTED and must NOT be escalated as findings. Built per native-adversary's noise-discipline rule: only deltas OUTSIDE this baseline are evidence.

operand_reserialization_order.observed: Engine re-serializes content-stream operands in reversed stack order (e.g. '1 0 0 1 100 700 Tm' -> '700 100 1 0 0 1 Tm', '/F1 18 Tf' -> '18 /F1 Tf').
operand_reserialization_order.rationale: Cosmetic round-trip artifact of PoDoFo's PdfVariantStack iteration. Does not change rendered output; both forms are valid PDF. NOT a finding.

rect_coordinate_flip.observed: Input QRectF (top-left origin) is flipped to PDF bottom-left via (pageHeight - y - h) at PoDoFoBackend.cpp:1635.
rect_coordinate_flip.rationale: Correct and intended Qt->PDF coordinate conversion. Harness rects must account for it; a mis-placed rect that 'leaks' is a TEST BUG, not a product bug.

edact_ray_numeric_gap.observed: Scrubbed text is replaced by a numeric-only TJ gap, e.g. '[ -7056 ] TJ', instead of removed entirely.
edact_ray_numeric_gap.rationale: Intentional Edact-Ray defense (PoDoFoBackend.cpp:1486-1504): preserves cursor advance without leaking per-glyph widths. The oracle treats a numeric-only TJ as CLEAN.

single_revision_after_writeUpdate_on_fre.observed: writeUpdate() on a freshly-loaded in-memory doc yields a single-revision file (xref_revisions=1), not an appended incremental revision.
single_revision_after_writeUpdate_on_fre.rationale: With no prior on-disk revision to append to, PoDoFo writes a fresh file. F-03's incremental-leak claim requires a doc that ALREADY has a revision on disk (e.g. a signed fixture) -- see MANIFEST 'NOT YET PROVEN'.
